content_of_post_to_comment:
(Like probably most here) Was motivated. Genuinely wanted to achieve big goals, had the plans, meant every word of it, (but again like probably most here) when it actually came time to do the work, I'd slack off, procrastinate and would just go out and drink

What actually changed it: I started writing an honest account of how yesterday actually went every morning (like an obituary, id read out loud in third person, talking about my life, but just for the previous day). That spike in typically hatred, guilt would force me to then start planning for exactly how today could go wrong before doing anything else (a pre-mortem). Read about Napoleon running through this mentally each day, and separately asked Claude what it'd do daily if it were human to actually hit its goals. The answer lined up almost exactly with what I'd already started doing on my own. Well back to that spike, that energy forced me to write out 3 major tasks and 3 smaller ones that needed to be complete today.

Once I saw it genuinely working, I built it into something that would actually hold me to it. Real proof required for anything I said I'd do, not just telling myself I did it. Which honestly felt like a relief, because i knew i couldn't fuel my brain with lies and stories that would accept falling through on an important task.

I get more done in some 4.5 hour work blocks now than I used to in a single week. Same person. Completely different structure.

Not telling anyone to specifically use my app for this. Any tool that actually forces proof instead of letting you check a box would probably help + some morning reflection ritual. You can literally just write it out on in a journal if you're mentally strong enough to stick to completing the tasks. Just trying to get better at this myself too, figured I'd share what's working. I turned mine into an app because I wanted to keep using it daily, and today it's live on the App Store, which is a cool achievement for me.

It has a paywall, but I'm happy to give free access to anybody genuinely interested in trying the method out. Just comment or DM.
